SEO is a compounding game, so it rewards consistency rather than a single post. Most people see their organic traffic roughly double within 6 months, and Penny regularly gets targeted keywords onto the first page of Google within three months. The earlier you start publishing regularly, the sooner that momentum kicks in. Will the posts read like a real person wrote them, or like obvious AI? This is the thing most people worry about, and it's fair — generic AI content is easy to spot. Penny studies your existing writing, your products, and your audience, then writes in your voice instead of a flat, robotic one. You can always tweak a draft, and she learns from every edit you make. Do I have to come up with the topics myself? No. Penny researches what your audience is actually searching for and proposes topics and angles that have a real chance of ranking. If you have specific ideas, products, or campaigns you want covered, you can hand them to her — otherwise she keeps the content calendar full on her own. Can Penny publish straight to my website? Yes. Penny connects directly to your site and publishes for you, so posts don't sit waiting in a draft folder. She works with WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Webflow, and essentially any common hosting platform. Do I get to review posts before they go live? If you want to. The whole point of Penny is that you don't have to learn SEO. She handles the keyword research, structure, and on-page details that Google cares about, and explains what she's doing in plain language whenever you ask.
